commonPrompt:
Create ONE finished, premium GAME UI COMPONENT DESIGN CONCEPT BOARD for TownGrid (타운그리드), a Korean isometric pixel-art town building, production chain, logistics and nation growth game. This is ONE OF FIVE competing visual directions, an isolated component specimen sheet, NOT a game screen layout, NOT a website or dashboard, NOT a moodboard of paintings. Landscape high-resolution 3:2 canvas. Plain warm-gray studio background #e7e5dd, no scenery, no map, no characters, no fake software chrome. Components must occupy most of the canvas, be separated with generous orderly gutters, large and readable. Tiny ornamental flourishes kept extremely restrained.

TownGrid's world mixes bright green countryside, amber timber workshops, cream plaster, teal tiled roofs, mines, railways, trucks, ports, magic towers and modern factories. Establish an original professional game interface art direction with crisp pixel-step silhouettes, flat pixel color clusters, purposeful layered borders, hand-crafted pixel inventory art, physical button press depth. NO smooth 3D, NO glassmorphism, NO generic SaaS cards, NO decorative wallpaper, NO distressed noise, NO photorealistic material textures, NO giant scenery illustration. Typography must be highly readable clean Korean sans, NOT mangled decorative pixel-font body text. Pixel geometry for art and edging; text remains clear. Emphasize functional hierarchy and usable large click targets. All panels should have calm quiet text areas and compact edging.

Use this exact SAME component specimen content and logical arrangement:
1. A concise top heading with concept number and Korean name specified below. Small subtitle with 3 material words. Do not redesign the actual TownGrid logo.
2. Upper row four chunky rectangular buttons: primary "건설", secondary "판매", visibly pressed selected "선택됨", inactive gray "잠김" with a small lock. Above the row small section label "버튼". Show tangible depth and distinct states, selected state has a check mark not just color.
3. A short detached strip of 3 resource counters with excellent pixel-art coin, stack-of-logs, stone icons, and numerals "1,250", "48", "32". Beside this a separate compact time control with pause, "1×", "2×", "4×" with 1× selected. These are specimens, not a HUD positioned on a map.
4. Lower left a compact tab strip labeled "기초", "생산", "운송", with production selected. Under it 3 building cards: "우물" with a lovely SMALL pixel-art isometric single-tile well, "벌목장" with a SMALL pixel-art isometric timber saw workshop, and locked "제철소" with a dimmed SMALL pixel-art industrial foundry and a clear lock overlay. Building artwork is only about 20% of total board. No invented gameplay mechanics. Include small familiar coin cost on first two "60" and "90". Cards rectangular, readable title and icon, selected lumber card gets unmistakable corner brackets or outline plus tick; locked text still readable.
5. Lower right one medium production detail panel labelled "제재소", a small close X, a status badge "생산 중", pixel-art log icon then right arrow then plank icon, a horizontal progress meter filled 65% and time "00:18". Two small inventory cells of log and plank with counts "12" and "8". One wide action button "생산 중지". No charts, no table, no paragraph body copy.
6. Bottom row three status examples "생산 중", "재료 부족", "운반 대기" with distinguishable simple icons; and compact square controls for rotate left, rotate right, plus, minus. One small tooltip sample "목재가 부족합니다". Status examples should look like real game assets. Restrained small palette swatches at far bottom right.
All Korean text accurately spelled. Empty space around components is for comparing shapes. Do NOT connect all specimen pieces into one giant app window. This image will be compared against four other distinct material and silhouette directions. Strong art direction, not merely a color swap. No extra prose or sections.

concepts.title: 개척자의 공방
concepts.style: TITLE "01 · 개척자의 공방". Subtitle "목재 · 크림 · 숲색". STYLE: Warm, tactile, optimistic handmade builder's workshop. Simple honey-oak pixel borders with a dark brown shadow edge, very sparse large wood joint marks, pale cream enamel inner surfaces, muted forest green action buttons with broad sage lit upper face and substantial darker 4-pixel lower lip. Medium stepped square corners, 2-layer bevel, small square brass corner caps only at structural corners. Tabs shaped like interlocking stout wooden drawer labels, selected has a cream inset and green ribbon tongue. Inventory counters are small wooden trays. Progress is an amber segmented bar inset into green. Cards are framed wood tiles with quiet cream centers; primary building card has green corner brackets. World aesthetic can evolve from farm to workshop to factory without rustic clutter. Wood is conveyed through large color blocks NOT busy grain. Welcoming and clearly game-like, rich saturated small inventory icons. Large legible dark-brown Korean text.

concepts.title: 왕립 상회
concepts.style: TITLE "02 · 왕립 상회". Subtitle "남색 · 상아 · 황동". STYLE: Refined mercantile empire strategy game, blue enamel trading-company instruments, not ornate fantasy RPG. Squared navy plaques with thin brass outer lines and ivory inset reading surfaces; corner geometry is shallow 45-degree octagonal clipped corners, bold but disciplined symmetrical double-line construction. Primary button warm brass with dark ink label, secondary navy with ivory label. Small square blue/gold seals used as state glyphs; no heraldic crest sprawl, no swords, no leather, no aged parchment. Tabs like compact navy stepped ledger index tabs with brass underlines. Resource containers look like tidy navy trading counters with a gold coin window. Build cards like elegant ivory inventory tickets held by navy/gold metal corner clips. Production panel navy header, ivory main body and restrained brass dividers. Progress bar blue segmented with a golden end marker. A state-selected card has conspicuous gold corner brackets and blue check badge. Feel orderly, confident and prestigious from early trading outpost to sovereign industrial power. Pixel art outlines and square highlights, no gradients or anti-aliased ornamental art.

concepts.title: 산업 제어반
concepts.style: TITLE "03 · 산업 제어반". Subtitle "에나멜 · 강철 · 주황". STYLE: Industrial management game instrument-panel components with sea-green/teal enamel metal, warm light-gray ceramic labels, dark iron outlines and vivid burnt-orange action controls. Bold almost square modular silhouettes, chunky 2-level bolted mounting corners, only four small rivets on major panels; no rivet noise. Physical rectangular rocker-style primary buttons with deep charcoal lower casing and orange top, inset rails for pressed state. Resource counters are mechanical digital readout boxes; numbers still ordinary clear type, not segmented fake digits. Tabs feel like short thick switch-bank selector tabs, selected has orange indicator notch. Cards have robust charcoal metal footing and light enamel interiors; selected lumber has orange corner lights plus check. Production bar inside a steel trough with teal-green thick fill and restrained vertical tick marks. Production detail is a working factory control box, clean ivory center, teal title plate, visibly separate orange stop action. Readable soft cream text on dark surfaces. A tiny yellow/black hazard accent only on material-shortage badge. This must be unmistakably a cozy pixel industry's machinery UI, not sci-fi and not dirty post-apocalyptic metal. Beautiful confident pixel shapes, mechanical usability.

concepts.title: 마도 공학
concepts.style: TITLE "04 · 마도 공학". Subtitle "백자 · 비취 · 수정". STYLE: Luminous clean magitech civilization technology integrated into practical craft. Bright ivory porcelain component surfaces framed in deep jade, restrained aqua crystal square inlays, extremely small violet highlights only for arcane accent. Distinctive 2-step chamfered white shells, bracketed corners with subtle bronze contacts; clean little diamond center marker on selected tabs. Primary solid deep-jade enamel button with ivory label, secondary ivory with jade border; pressed shows inward stepped edge. NO purple glass panels, NO holograms, NO excessive glow, NO floating particles, NO mystical alphabet. Only simple square circuit-like seams, 1 or 2 pixel rune inlays at structural corners, readable Korean everywhere. Build cards like compact white ceramic modules clipped into jade frames, selected aqua corner brackets and tick. Resource counters shallow ivory capsule rectangles with stepped not rounded edges and jade side flanges. Progress meter is a row of clear aqua pixel crystal segments within a dark jade channel. Production panel calm ivory, jade header, a small restrained prism indicator next to production status. Typography charcoal-jade. The effect should be fresh, sophisticated, light, magical AND engineered, compatible with farms, trains, power generation. A crystal is a small detail, never giant centerpiece. Crisp pixel construction, broad simple color masses.

concepts.title: 모던 픽셀
concepts.style: TITLE "05 · 모던 픽셀". Subtitle "차콜 · 아이보리 · 라임". STYLE: Contemporary premium pixel town-builder interface with bold compact handheld-console / modern game-control character. This is the least ornamented but most decisively game-tactile choice. Strong graphic squared forms with 2-pixel stepped corner cuts, deep graphite charcoal body, warm ivory button faces and lettering, vivid lime/chartreuse selected accents and a small sky-blue informational secondary. Flat clean pixel surfaces, 3-pixel hard offset black shadow, ZERO texture, ZERO metal/wood filigree, ZERO generic web drop shadow or pills. Buttons are substantial keycap-like extruded rectangles with ivory or chartreuse top, charcoal low face; selected button visibly pressed with black pixel tick. Resource counters compact horizontal charcoal bars with bright colorful pixel resource icons, large ivory numbers. Tabs are joined stepped console keys, selected chartreuse with dark text. Build cards have oversized readable vivid pixel building icons against graphite inset, ivory title, thin hard boundaries; selected lime pixel corners and tick; locked dim blue-gray with visible gray lock. Production panel dark matte graphite with ivory title, large mint progress fill, strong separation via negative space not decorative divider lines. Inventory slots tangible square inset trays. Status labels combine precise pixel shapes and concise color. It should feel like an excellent purpose-built modern pixel GAME, intuitive and bold at small sizes, not a dashboard or analytics app. No neon bloom.
